verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents service accounts that grant programmatic API access without tying credentials to individual users, for any non-human system, which covers agents. Separately, it documents custom roles built from fine-grained transactions assigned to principals, which suggests least-privilege scoping. The evidence never explicitly says service accounts can be bound to custom roles, and nothing addresses MCP or agent credentials specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that service-account keys can be scoped to custom or least-privilege roles, per-key scope or expiry details, agent/MCP-specific credential guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
